currentParagraphText: Despite throwing a few angry glances towards Minaga, Dina was clearly happy as she turned to the Sword Saint. “We should hurry up and recover. The King is at Jake’s residence, right?”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I would assume so,” the Sword Saint said, finding it amusing that Dina purposefully avoided speaking to the Unique Lifeform.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “But do not fret, instead, you can meet this new guy called the Golden Forest King.
